selection: User requested stopping optimization and using the current passing candidate as final.
freeze_scope: Exact existing RTL, firmware and numeric configuration. No RTL/firmware/config edits. New evidence files only; existing project_manifest.json untouched.

original_firmware_compile_record.scope: Firmware compilation only. Real CPU execution, external producer integration and full-window throughput pending.

firmware_execution_qualification: The copied compile record predates SoC replay and says executed_on_e203=false; this is superseded by the selected passing 12-task real-E203 run, retained without rewriting history.

numeric_contract.rounding: nearest-even signed magnitude, then signed13 saturation

measurement.end: actual final output completion marker response ACK
measurement.includes: source loading, CPU control, all arbitration/waits/compute/output writes
measurement.excludes: host file read and format conversion; firmware preload/boot

limits: Historical frozen Q12 fixtures; not current official accuracy dataset
Behavioral synchronous SRAM, no manufacturer macro timing or power
150 MHz is assumed; no STA signoff
Each task launches a separate simulation with global reset; not an uninterrupted encoder chain
External loader input boundary is explicit hardware, but organizer acceptance of the added platform interface remains pending
